measures.name: Safety
measures.desc: Students feel safe both in and around the school building.

measures.name: School Safety
measures.desc: Students encounter very little crime, violence, or bullying at school.

measures.name: Student-Teacher Trust
measures.desc: Students and teachers share a high level of mutual trust and respect.

measures.name: Student Peer Relationships
measures.desc: Students treat each other with respect, work well together, and help each other learn.

measures.name: Parent Supportiveness
measures.desc: Parents support their children emotionally and developmentally.

measures.name: School Connectedness
measures.desc: Students feel included in their school's community.

measures.name: Emotional Health
measures.desc: Students have the skills to nurture positive and respectful relationships with others.

measures.name: Human & Social Resources in the Community
measures.desc: Students come from communities where there are adults they can trust who provide a safe environment.

measures.name: Rigorous Study Habits
measures.desc: Students set aside time for schoolwork and give priority to studying.

measures.name: Classroom Disruptions
measures.desc: Teachers report on the degree to which other students disrupt their learning.

measures.name: Collective Responsibility
measures.desc: Teachers share a strong sense of responsibility for student development, school improvement, and professional growth.

measures.name: Student Responsibility
measures.desc: Students are active participants in their own learning and regularly attend class prepared to learn.

measures.name: Parent Influence on Decision Making in Schools
measures.desc: The school has created opportunities for parents to participate in developing academic programs and influencing school curricula.

measures.name: Teacher-Parent Trust
measures.desc: Teachers and parents are partners in improving student learning.

measures.name: Parent Involvement in School
measures.desc: Parents are active participants in their child's schooling.
